description: This file defines functions related to configuring and logging updates to configuration paths in a TypeScript project. It includes utility functions for formatting config paths and logging configuration updates, using imports for runtime environment, display utilities, and I/O-related functions.

methods.name: export function formatConfigPath(path: string = createConfigIO().configPath): string { formatConfigPath
methods.description: Formats a configuration path, defaulting to the path returned by createConfigIO().configPath, and returns its display form.

methods.name: export function logConfigUpdated(runtime: RuntimeEnv, opts: LogConfigUpdatedOptions = {}): void / logConfigUpdated
methods.description: Logs an update message indicating that a configuration path has been updated, including optional suffix.
